notes.title: Industrial Firefighters Version 2.0 is Here! 🚒🔥 (Free Update!)
notes.content:
[h1]Attention Firefighters![/h1]

We are excited to announce the launch of [b]Industrial Firefighters Version 2.0[/b], our biggest update yet, and the best part—it’s completely [b]FREE[/b] to all players! 🎉

[h2]Here’s what’s new:[/h2]

[h3]🖥️ Highly Improved Graphics[/h3]
Prepare to be blown away by stunning, revamped visuals! The game now looks better than ever, with more realistic textures and a beautifully optimized look.

[h3]🌍 Much More Detail in the Game World[/h3]
Immerse yourself in a richer, more detailed world. Every corner, every building, and every object has been carefully enhanced to bring your firefighting experience to life.

[h3]🚒 New Engine Version[/h3]
We've upgraded to a brand-new engine, making the game run smoother and allowing for more complex simulations and improved gameplay.

[h3]🌤️ Dynamic Sky[/h3]
Experience firefighting in different weather conditions with our new dynamic sky feature! Watch as day turns to night and weather shifts while you're on the job.

[h3]🔥 New Burnable Object Types[/h3]
A host of new objects can now catch fire! Test your firefighting skills against more variety in emergencies, with an expanded array of burnable materials.

[h3]🚨 More Burnable Objects[/h3]
The world is more hazardous than ever! There are now more burnable objects throughout the environment, giving you fresh challenges on every call.

[h2]Thank You for Your Support![/h2]

This free update is our way of saying thank you to our amazing firefighting community. Jump in today, and let us know what you think about the new improvements. We can’t wait to see you in action!

Stay safe and happy firefighting,
The Industrial Firefighters Team 🔥🧑‍🚒

notes.title: Update to version 1.2
notes.content:
With version 1.2 the game now supports 11 language for text.
-German
-English
-French
-Italien
-Spanish
-Russian
-Turkish
-Dutch
-Portuguese
-Polish
-Hungarian
